requirements_summary: Primary workload: customer-facing chat (support agent) + doc-search reranker; secondary: code-assistant for internal tools
Target latency: P50 <= 120ms for streaming tokens, P95 <= 600ms for end-to-end chat responses
Peak QPS target (inbound requests to Redwood): ~40 QPS during peak 2-hour window
Peak concurrency (active sessions generating requests): ~180 concurrent chat sessions; effective concurrency for model inference ~48 (due to batching and streaming overlap)
Token mix (observed during hosted trial): 70% short requests (<128 tokens total), 20% mid (128-512), 10% long (>512) — avg tokens/request ~540 (prompt+response), avg generated tokens ~200
Throughput expectation: 15M tokens/month baseline; forecasting growth to 45M tokens/month in 6 months if adoption successful
Availability/SLOs: require 99.9% uptime for user-facing flows; fallbacks acceptable to lower-tier model with graceful degradation
Model preferences: open-models preferred (Llama2-chat 13B quantized, Mistral-family), but willing to consider Redwood-verified variants for latency and cost
Routing/fallback needs: automatic fallback to a smaller quantized model when Dedicated pool saturated; prefer region-aware routing (NA primary, EU for EU customers)
Security/compliance: VPC peering + SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for key management, explicit data residency for EU customers
notes: Trial feedback: hosting integration straightforward; SDK examples reused across team
AE notes: product team likes Console metrics breakdown (token-level costs) — cited as helpful for budgeting
Quote from Head of Product (call 2026-02-25): 'We need predictable p99 latency for customer chat — intermittent spikes are killing UX',
SE Diego: suggested Dedicated pool with 2x reserve for headroom + burst policy; recommended 4 gpus of A10-ish equivalent for initial commit
Finance: wants 12-month committed pricing tiers; open to quarterly pilot but prefers commit if SLAs included
Security: flagged data residency; wants written confirmation around where embeddings are stored and region of KMS keys
POC acceptance criteria draft: 1) P95 latency under 700ms for standard chat flow; 2) no more than 1% error rate during 48h soak; 3) token cost per 1K under negotiated threshold
